text.p: Sunbeam Corp said Tuesday it had agreed to sell its furniture division to a unit of U.S. Industries Inc.
The deal's total value for Sunbeam, including the value of retained assets, is expected to be in excess of $120 million at closing, the company said.
It said the transaction includes the sale of its furniture factories, related equipment and inventory and furniture trademarks.
It said it was retaining accounts receivable and certain fixed assets.
The furniture business consists primarily of outdoor aluminum, wrought iron and resin patio furniture. The deal is expected to close within 30 days, it said.
Al Dunlap, Sunbeam chairman and chief executive officer, said the sale was part of the company's divestiture plan for non-core businesses.
